questions.question: You are driving on a road where this road sign is displayed. What is the safest interpretation of the sign ahead?

options.text: Reduce speed only for the first bend and resume normal speed afterwards
Prepare for a single right-hand bend and maintain the normal speed limit thereafter
Expect continuous winding roads for the next 8 km and do not exceed 60 km/h during that section
The road becomes one-way for 8 km with a speed limit of 60 km/h

questions.explanation: The supplementary plate (For 8 km) gives the length of the hazard, the winding-road warning sign shows the hazard, and the 60 km/h speed limit sign applies throughout that section.

questions.question: A motor vehicle licence disc expires on 31 July. Assuming all other requirements are met, for how long may the vehicle still legally be operated using the expired licence disc?

options.text: 7 days
14 days
21 days
30 days

questions.explanation: There is a 21-day grace period after the expiry date of a motor vehicle licence disc.

questions.question: While driving a truck carrying a tall metal structure, you notice a warning sign ahead. Which situation presents the greatest risk?

options.text: A narrow bridge ahead
Low-hanging tree branches ahead
Overhead electrical power cables crossing the road
A railway line crossing the road

questions.explanation: The lightning-bolt warning sign warns of overhead electrical cables; tall loads risk contact with the cables.

questions.question: Which of the following persons may legally obtain a learner's licence despite having a medical condition?

options.text: A person with uncontrolled epilepsy
A person with uncontrolled diabetes mellitus
A deaf person with no other disqualifying condition
A person suffering sudden attacks of disabling fainting

questions.explanation: Deafness alone is not a disqualifying condition. Uncontrolled epilepsy, uncontrolled diabetes and sudden disabling fainting are disqualifying (controlled conditions are not).

questions.question: A driver of a delivery vehicle approaches a road displaying a sign together with the time period 06:00-09:00. What is the correct interpretation?

options.text: Delivery vehicles are prohibited from using the route between 06:00 and 09:00
Only delivery vehicles may enter the route between 06:00 and 09:00
Delivery vehicles must use the designated lane or route between 06:00 and 09:00
Delivery vehicles may stop in the route only between 06:00 and 09:00

questions.explanation: A blue circular sign is a command (mandatory) sign, not a prohibition: delivery vehicles must use this lane/route during the times shown.

questions.question: A Code 1 learner’s licence holder is 17 years old. Which motorcycle may they legally ride on a public road?

options.text: Any motorcycle provided no passenger is carried
Only a motorcycle not exceeding 125 cc cylinder capacity
Any motorcycle under 3500 kg GVM
A motorcycle exceeding 125 cc if supervised by a licensed rider

questions.explanation: A Code 1 learner under 18 may only ride a motorcycle with an engine capacity not exceeding 125 cm³.

questions.question: A tourist travelling through the city approaches a road displaying a prohibition sign showing a rickshaw symbol. Which road user is directly affected by the sign?

options.text: Pedal cyclists only
Animal-drawn carts only
Rickshaws may not proceed beyond the sign
All slow-moving vehicles are prohibited

questions.explanation: This prohibition sign only prohibits rickshaws; bicycles, carts and other slow vehicles have their own signs.

questions.question: A motor vehicle is fitted with a windscreen. What is the minimum visible light transmission permitted through that windscreen?
questions.explanation: A windscreen must allow at least 70% visible light transmission.

questions.question: A vehicle transporting hazardous chemicals approaches this sign. What is the correct interpretation?

options.text: Dangerous-goods vehicles are prohibited from using the route during the displayed times
Dangerous-goods vehicles may choose whether to use the route during the displayed times
Dangerous-goods vehicles must use the designated route during the displayed times
Dangerous-goods vehicles may use the route only with police escort

questions.explanation: This is a mandatory (command) route sign: vehicles carrying dangerous goods must use this designated route during the specified period.

questions.question: A vehicle capable of reaching 70 km/h is being used on a public road. Which statement is correct?

options.text: A speedometer is only required on freeways
A speedometer is required only if the vehicle exceeds 80 km/h
A speedometer is optional if the driver knows the vehicle's speed
The vehicle must be fitted with a working speedometer

questions.explanation: A vehicle capable of 60 km/h or more must be fitted with a speedometer in good working order.
